findings.issue: Exercise ex:n3-enfase-02-2 (子供＿＿＿＿大人も楽しめる) has a second acceptable choice: 子供ばかりか大人も楽しめる is fully grammatical and means essentially the same. The explanation itself concedes 'ばかりか também funcionaria gramaticalmente'. Replace the distractor.
findings.current: choices: ["はもちろん", "ばかりか", "だけで", "でさえ"] / explanation: "ばかりか também funcionaria gramaticalmente, mas é bem mais formal"
findings.suggested: Trocar o distrator "ばかりか" por "ばかり" (子供ばかり大人も楽しめる é agramatical) e remover a ressalva sobre ばかりか da explicação.

findings.issue: The explanation claims 断る and 異なる have very different kana, but ことわる vs ことなる differ by a single mora (わ/な) — that similarity is exactly why they are confused. The statement contradicts its own warning and misleads the learner.
findings.current: Cuidado para não confundir 断る (recusar) com 異なる (diferir): kana e sentido são bem diferentes.
findings.suggested: Cuidado para não confundir 断る (ことわる, recusar) com 異なる (ことなる, diferir): o kana muda em uma só sílaba (わ/な), mas o sentido é totalmente outro.

findings.issue: Tense mismatch in the ばかりか example: the first clause is non-past (雨が降る) while the second clause and the pt-BR gloss are past (風も強くなった / 'não só choveu'). For a completed past event ばかりか should attach to the た-form (雨が降った).
findings.current: <jp reading="あめがふるばかりか、かぜもつよくなった">雨が降るばかりか、風も強くなった</jp> = "não só choveu, como também o vento ficou forte"
findings.suggested: 雨が降ったばかりか、風も強くなった (reading: あめがふったばかりか、かぜもつよくなった) — ajustar também o enunciado/gabarito do cloze ex:n3-enfase-02-3.

findings.issue: The lead-in to the vocabulary list announces loanwords ('estrangeirismos/gairaigo'), but only 3 of the 15 items (コーチ, ゴール, コード) are gairaigo; the rest are Sino-Japanese words (語学, 国語, 黒板, 誤解...). The framing does not match the list.

findings.issue: Lead-in to the vocabulary list calls the whole list 'estrangeirismos (gairaigo)', but 12 of the 15 items are Sino-Japanese words (語学, 国語, 黒板, 誤解, 考慮, 候補, 呼吸, 故郷, 氷, 凍る, 越える, 極). Only コーチ/ゴール/コード are gairaigo.

findings.issue: In ex:n3-enfase-03-5 the warning claims the kana of 断る and 異なる are 'bem diferentes', but ことわる vs ことなる differ by a single mora (and ことわざ is even closer) — that near-identity is exactly why they are confusable. The claim is false and self-defeating.
findings.current: Cuidado para não confundir 断る (recusar) com 異なる (diferir): kana e sentido são bem diferentes.
findings.suggested: Cuidado para não confundir 断る (ことわる), 異なる (ことなる) e 諺 (ことわざ): o kana muda por uma sílaba só, mas o sentido é bem diferente.

findings.issue: Tense clash in the ばかりか example: non-past 降る in the first clause with past 強くなった in the second reads as habitual/future, while the pt gloss says 'choveu'. Natural Japanese would use 降っている/降った. Same frame is reused in exercise ex:n3-enfase-02-3.
findings.current: <jp reading="あめがふるばかりか、かぜもつよくなった">雨が降るばかりか、風も強くなった</jp>
findings.suggested: 雨が降っているばかりか、風も強くなってきた (reading: あめがふっているばかりか、かぜもつよくなってきた)

findings.issue: The rule 'O 決して abre a frase' is inaccurate and is contradicted by the lesson's own next example (このことは決して言わない): 決して precedes the negated predicate, not necessarily the sentence.
findings.current: O <jp>決して</jp> abre a frase e exige um verbo no negativo depois.
findings.suggested: O 決して vem antes do predicado negado (no início da frase ou logo depois do tema) e exige um verbo no negativo.

findings.issue: Gloss for コード includes 'programa', which is not a sense of コード (programa = プログラム). コード means code (programming/cipher) or cord/cable.
